FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'oui' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. yes
   C. Sir, Mr
   D. hello, good day

2. What does 'le frigo' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bathroom
   B. the bed
   C. the chair
   D. the fridge

3. How do you say 'Where is the cat?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   B. Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   C. Où est le chat ?
   D. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

4. What does 'le canapé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bedroom
   B. the bag
   C. the bed
   D. the sofa

5. How do you say 'On Saturday, I play.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Une semaine, sept jours.
   B. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   C. Le jeudi, je chante.
   D. Le samedi, je joue.

6. Which month is 'septembre'? (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. March
   C. May
   D. September

7. How do you say 'Thank you very much!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je chante et je danse.
   B. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   C. Merci beaucoup !
   D. J'ai dix ans.

8. What number is 'sept' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 8
   D. 25

9. Fill in: C'est ______ gâteau. (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. des
   C. une
   D. un

10. How do you say 'It is not good for your health.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un gâteau.
   B. J'aime le lait.
   C. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   D. Je n'aime pas le poisson.

11. What does 'le maïs' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. chips
   B. juice
   C. maize
   D. the carrot

12. How do you say 'She has long hair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux mains.
   B. Elle a les cheveux longs.
   C. J'ai deux oreilles.
   D. Elle est petite.

13. Fill in: J'ai ______ bouche. (1) (1 mark)
   A. un
   B. le
   C. deux
   D. une

14. What does 'la neige' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the snow
   B. the wind
   C. the storm
   D. the weather

15. What does 'le soleil' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sun
   B. a flood
   C. the snow
   D. the weather

16. Fill in: Tournez ______ . (Turn left.) (1 mark)
   A. tout droit
   B. à droite
   C. à gauche
   D. devant

17. What does 'le jardin' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the key
   B. the garden
   C. the rug
   D. the shop

18. What does 'à gauche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the left
   B. to the right
   C. next to
   D. near

19. Which letters say oo in bonjour? (1 mark)
   A. oi
   B. on
   C. ou
   D. au

20. How is ê said in fête? (1 mark)
   A. oo
   B. eh
   C. ay
   D. ee

21. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: Where is the bed? (1 mark)
   A. in the kitchen
   B. near the fridge
   C. behind the door
   D. under the window

22. Which little word goes with 'télé' (the TV)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

23. Fill in: Le ballon est ______ la porte. (behind) (1 mark)
   A. devant
   B. sur
   C. entre
   D. derrière

24. What does 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My birthday is on 12 May.
   B. Here is a present for you.
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. I am nine years old.

25. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: How many candles are there? (1 mark)
   A. ten
   B. twelve
   C. two
   D. five

26. What does 'Voici un cadeau pour toi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am nine years old.
   B. Happy birthday!
   C. Here is a present for you.
   D. My birthday is on 12 May.

27. What does 'J'aime la mangue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning, I eat bread.
   B. I like the mango.
   C. I do not like fish.
   D. I drink a juice.

28. What does 'J'ai deux yeux.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two eyes.
   B. He has short hair.
   C. I have two ears.
   D. I have a nose.

29. Which little word goes with 'pied' (the foot)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

30. What does 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She is short.
   B. She has long hair.
   C. He is tall.
   D. Touch your nose!

31. What does 'Il fait beau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I stay in the house.
   B. Tomorrow the weather is nice.
   C. It is hot.
   D. The weather is nice.

32. What does 'De rien !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome!
   B. Turn left.
   C. Excuse me, where is the school?
   D. The rug is under the table.

33. What does 'Tournez à droite.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is on the table.
   B. Turn right.
   C. The TV is on the table.
   D. You are welcome!

34. How do you say 'the mother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la grand-mère
   B. la mère
   C. la famille
   D. la sœur

35. How do you write the number 1 in French? (1 mark)
   A. quinze
   B. sept
   C. un
   D. trois

36. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'December'? (1 mark)
   A. dècembre
   B. décembre
   C. décebre
   D. decembre

37. How do you say 'rice' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le riz
   B. l'eau
   C. les fruits
   D. la santé

38. How do you say 'fruits' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le poisson
   B. les fruits
   C. le lait
   D. la tomate

39. How do you say 'The weather is nice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait beau.
   B. Il fait froid.
   C. Il y a des nuages.
   D. Il pleut.

40. How do you say 'It is hot.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait beau.
   B. Il fait chaud.
   C. Il fait froid.
   D. Il pleut.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix doigts.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Write the French words for: the head, black, the foot (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Write the French words for: a flood, the wind, the storm (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'Go straight ahead.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Explain how to search safely on the internet when you look for a text about the body. (4 marks) (4 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'Here is my family.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'It is the first of January.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'Good evening, Madam!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I rest.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Le livre est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

51. Write three sentences in French to say where objects are in a room. Use three different position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandmother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

53. Write a small menu of four foods in French. (4 marks) (4 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Sort into friendly and harsh weather: le soleil, l'orage, le beau temps, le vent très fort. (4 marks) (4 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'I have a mouth.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'What is the weather like?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I play.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est devant le canapé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into English: 'Elle est petite.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'Goodbye, Sir.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — yes
   oui means yes.

2. D — the fridge
   le frigo means the fridge.

3. C — Où est le chat ?
   Where is the cat? in French is Où est le chat ?

4. D — the sofa
   le canapé means the sofa.

5. D — Le samedi, je joue.
   On Saturday, I play. in French is Le samedi, je joue.

6. D — September
   septembre means September.

7. C — Merci beaucoup !
   Thank you very much! in French is Merci beaucoup !

8. A — 7
   sept means 7.

9. D — un
   Gâteau is masculine.

10. C — Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   It is not good for your health. in French is Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.

11. C — maize
   le maïs means maize.

12. B — Elle a les cheveux longs.
   She has long hair. in French is Elle a les cheveux longs.

13. D — une
   Bouche is feminine, so une bouche.

14. A — the snow
   la neige means the snow.

15. A — the sun
   le soleil means the sun.

16. C — à gauche
   À gauche means to the left.

17. B — the garden
   le jardin means the garden.

18. A — to the left
   à gauche means to the left.

19. C — ou
   The letters ou say oo.

20. B — eh
   The circumflex ê is said like eh.

21. D — under the window
   Mon lit est sous la fenêtre.

22. C — la
   télé is feminine, so we say la télé.

23. D — derrière
   Derrière means behind.

24. A — My birthday is on 12 May.
   Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai. means My birthday is on 12 May.

25. A — ten
   Dix bougies means ten candles.

26. C — Here is a present for you.
   Voici un cadeau pour toi. means Here is a present for you.

27. B — I like the mango.
   J'aime la mangue. means I like the mango.

28. A — I have two eyes.
   J'ai deux yeux. means I have two eyes.

29. D — le
   pied is masculine, so we say le pied.

30. B — She has long hair.
   Elle a les cheveux longs. means She has long hair.

31. D — The weather is nice.
   Il fait beau. means The weather is nice.

32. A — You are welcome!
   De rien ! means You are welcome!

33. B — Turn right.
   Tournez à droite. means Turn right.

34. B — la mère
   the mother in French is la mère.

35. C — un
   1 in French is un.

36. B — décembre
   The correct spelling is décembre, with its accents.

37. A — le riz
   rice in French is le riz.

38. B — les fruits
   fruits in French is les fruits.

39. A — Il fait beau.
   The weather is nice. in French is Il fait beau..

40. B — Il fait chaud.
   It is hot. in French is Il fait chaud..
